payload.finding: precision means drop seeds with no flags (_mean skips None): primary cell, 4 of 20 seeds had no C flag. Pooled precision is also 1.0 (34/34 flagged traders skilled), so the result is unaffected; the criterion failed on recall. Future studies: report pooled precision and flag counts.

skill.precision_at_k breaks ties by list order and simulate.population lists skilled traders first, so the discrete win rate gets ties resolved in favour of skilled traders. Dev seeds 9000-9009, primary cell: win rate prec_top5pct 0.528 with index ties vs 0.496 with a random order (passers_top20pct 0.473 vs 0.459). The reported win-rate prec_top5pct 0.5145 is inflated by about 0.03; AUC (rankdata, ties averaged) and the success criterion are unaffected. Same bias in the SKILL-03/04 win-rate rows. Future studies: skill.precision_at_k_ties.

cause of S1 top-decile over-confidence identified: P(true mean > 0) lets breakeven traders (true mean exactly 0, 37 % of the top decile) leak probability above 0. Dev seeds 9000-9009, primary cell, top decile predicted vs actual: eb P(>0) 0.700 vs 0.335; eb P(>cost) 0.397 vs 0.335; npmle P(>cost) 0.329 vs 0.333. Resolved in SKILL-04.
